|gprice = 2500 |value = {{Price|300}} |stats = {{Name|Defense|+4}}{{Name|Immunity|+2}} }} '''Dark Boots''' are a [[footwear]] item in Stardew Valley. They can be purchased from the [[Adventurer's Guild]] after reaching floor 80 in [[The Mines]], or found in [[Fishing#Treasure Chests|Fishing Treasure Chests]]. They can be found as a [[The Mines#Special Items|special item]] on floors 81-119 of [[The Mines]], in the [[Skull Cavern]], or in the [[Quarry Mine]] by killing [[The Mines#Special Items|special monsters]] or by breaking [[The Mines#Crates and Barrels|crates and barrels]].
